name: Castrol India Ltd
about: Castrol India Ltd is principally engaged in the business of manufacturing & marketing of automotive and industrial lubricants and related services.[1]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio[1]
The company manufactures and sells various kinds of oil lubricants and other fluids for cars, motorcycles, commercial vehicles, industrial use, energy sector, marine and IT cooling and data centre.

pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 4.44%.
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 43.3%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 101%
cons: Stock is trading at 10.4 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.71% over past five years.
